excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
excerpt.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
texts.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

sections.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
sections.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上找到的并非是建筑，而是十分普通的矿物岩层。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些岩层之所以会露出地面，是因为不同的地壳构造版块互相撞击而形成的，其形状的特殊性是由行星地壳中不同寻常的物理构造造成的。

因为其形状过于工整，看起来某种外星生物似乎曾经对[From.GetName]的地壳进行过改动。
texts.en:
What the [Root.GetName] found on [From.GetName] were not buildings, but surprisingly regular mineral outcroppings. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] asserts that these angular blocks of rock are the product of interactions between tectonic plates, their shapes the result of the unusual tectonophysics inherent in the planet's crust.

The perfect angularity of these thrust faults implies a possibility of aliens tampering with [From.GetName]'s crust at some point in the past.

tooltips.en:
Adds the Unusual Tectonics modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +2
£physics£ +2

texts.zh:
轨道上探查出的影像的确是建筑。进一步调查后发现建筑显然是用于军事用途。虽然被遗弃了一段时间——从星系尺度上看并不算久——但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为从尘土下的废弃军营和空旷的军火库中仍然可以找到外星战术秘密。

已经设立了研究废墟的特殊项目。
texts.en:
The silhouettes discernible from orbit are indeed buildings, and closer inspection reveal them to be of an obvious martial nature. While abandoned for some time - though very recently on a galactic timescale - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that secrets of alien tactics may yet be exhumed from beneath the dust that covers the decaying barracks and looted armories.

A Special Project may be issued to study the remains.

label.zh: 既然已经化为废墟，那就不要多管了。
label.en: That this outpost is dead and buried speaks volumes.

texts.zh: 一项对于这些废墟的最新异种社会考古学研究也许能帮助我们理解这些古代外星战争机器。
texts.en: A closer xeno-socio-archaeological study of these ruins may provide insights into some past alien war machine.

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对于[From.From.GetName]进行了详尽的外星历史分析，但最终结果不佳。该兵营早在行星变得贫瘠之前就被建立了，但不知是因为自然原因还是战争原因，才变成了今天这样的废墟。

可以得出的结论是：这些外星人使用的武器与战略并不比我们现在使用的要先进。

不过，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]说自己因为这次勘探，获取了不少灵感。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s thorough xeno-historical analysis of the military installation on [From.From.GetName] has yielded few tangible results. The base was constructed before the planet turned completely barren, but it is unclear if its current inhospitality is the result of armed conflict or some more peaceful or even natural process.

What can be deduced of their strategies and tactics in armed conflict does not seem to have been far in advance of our own.

On the upside, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have drawn much inspiration from the alien remnants.
